title: Custom IAM policies must add ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes (mandatory in a future release)

detection.reason: the controller's IAM policy is AWS-side; IRSA shows only the role ARN and EKS Pod Identity nothing at all

quote: If you use a custom IAM policy, you will need to add `DescribeInstanceTypes` to your policy.
remediation: Add ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes to a custom EBS CSI policy now. From v1.59 the driver calls it to handle instances with several EBS cards and falls back to a built-in table when denied; a later release removes the fallback. The AWS-managed policies include it. While here, consider the new least-privilege managed policies (issue #2918).
verifyCommand: kubectl -n kube-system get sa ebs-csi-controller-sa -o jsonpath='{.metadata.annotations.eks\.amazonaws\.com/role-arn}{"\n"}'  # prints the controller's IRSA role (empty = EKS Pod Identity or node role); list its policies with aws iam list-attached-role-policies --role-name ROLE_NAME
coversNotes: URGENT (1.59.0): The EBS CSI Driver now calls DescribeInstanceTypes at runtime to determine if an instance
URGENT (1.59.0): New AWS-managed IAM policies are available for the EBS CSI Driver that restrict the IAM
Call DescribeInstanceTypes at runtime for EBS multi-card instances
